# crosswork_l3vpn_qos_profile_ids (Data Source)

This data source can read a QoS profile id of the L3VPN service model.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "crosswork_l3vpn_qos_profile_ids" "example" {
  id   = "cwtest-qos"
  name = "cwtest-qos"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The id of the object
- `name` (String) Name of the QoS profile. Any ASCII character except `%`, `?` and `#`.

### Optional

- `instance` (String) Select an instance of the provider configuration by its name. Leave it unset to use the default instance.
